routeHint: Settings -> Single sign-on. The route is gated on the Orgo administrator flag (router.js:1812, ROLE_ADMIN_TENANT) and the screen itself is gated on settingFeatures.integrations.ssoOidc (SingleSignOn.vue:601). PREREQUISITE: that flag must be on for tenant 282, or the page renders only the 'not enabled for your organisation' notice. Enable it as a demo-seeding write on the gated docs database before capturing. UPDATED 2026-11-11: there are TWO switches, and the first capture caught only the refusal because of the second. OidcFeatureGate needs the deployment key OIDC_SECRET_ENCRYPTION_KEY set (unset means off everywhere) AND settingFeatures.integrations.ssoOidc true on the tenant. With the key unset the screen renders nothing but 'Sign-in with your own identity provider is not enabled for your organisation yet'. A random key was written into api/.env on this instance, which is git-ignored, and orgo-1-php restarted.
alt: The single sign-on screen before any provider is connected, laid out as three numbered steps: create an app in your identity provider with the redirect address to copy, connect it to Orgo with the Add identity provider button, and test, verify your domain and activate
notes: New page platform/single-sign-on.mdx has no image. Show the empty state with the setup guide, which is what an admin sees before connecting anything.
